message.content:
Here’s a quick‑start guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold—whether you’re looking for a local deal, a national marketplace, or a consignment shop.

---

## 1. Prep Your Guitar

| Step | What to Do | Why It Matters |
|------|------------|----------------|
| **Clean & Tune** | Give it a good wipe‑down and bring it up to pitch. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing. |
| **Take Photos** | Capture front, back, side, headstock, soundhole, and any flaws. Use natural light and a neutral background. | High‑quality images attract buyers and reduce questions. |
| **Write a Description** | Include brand, model, year, wood type, finish, condition, and any upgrades (e.g., new strings, pickups). Mention any known issues honestly. | Transparency builds trust and reduces returns. |
| **Research Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, and local shops for comparable models. | Helps you price competitively. |

---

## 2. Choose Where to Sell

| Platform | Best For | Tips |
|----------|----------|------|
| **Reverb.com** | Musical‑instrument specialists | Free listing; paid “Featured” option; built‑in shipping calculator. |
| **eBay** | Broad audience + auction option | Use “Best Offer” or fixed price; include shipping costs. |
| **Craigslist / Gumtree** | Local, no shipping | Meet in a public place; ask for cash or Venmo. |
| **Facebook Marketplace** | Local, easy sharing | Verify buyer’s profile; use “Ask for Price” feature. |
| **Local Music Stores** | Consignment or direct sale | Many shops offer consignment; they’ll handle marketing and shipping. |
| **Pawn Shops / Instrument Resale Shops** | Quick cash | Get a quote first; they’ll often buy outright. |

---

## 3. Create a Listing

1. **Title** – Keep it clear: “Fender American Professional II Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition.”
2. **Photos** – Upload at least 5–7 shots.
3. **Description** – Use bullet points for specs, add a short paragraph about playability and feel.
4. **Price** – Set a realistic asking price (e.g., $350–$450 for a mid‑range model).
5. **Shipping** – If selling online, calculate cost with a padded case or gig bag. Offer free shipping if you can afford it—it often boosts sales.

---

## 4. Handle Inquiries & Negotiations

| Question | Suggested Response |
|----------|--------------------|
| “What’s the condition?” | “It’s been lightly used, no cracks, recently tuned, and has a fresh set of strings.” |
| “Can you lower the price?” | “I’m open to offers within 10% of my asking price.” |
| “Do you ship internationally?” | “Yes, I can ship worldwide with insurance.” |

Keep communication polite, prompt, and professional. Use the platform’s messaging system whenever possible.

---

## 5. Finalizing the Sale

| Step | How to Do It | Safety Tip |
|------|--------------|------------|
| **Meet in Person** | Arrange a public location (coffee shop, police station) if selling locally. | Bring a friend or family member. |
| **Accept Payment** | Cash, Venmo, PayPal Goods & Services (buyer protection). | Never accept personal checks unless you’ve verified them. |
| **Ship Safely** | Pack in a hard case or sturdy gig bag, use bubble wrap, and insure the package. | Label clearly and keep tracking info. |
| **Transfer Ownership** | Sign a simple bill of sale; keep a copy for yourself. | Protects both parties legally. |

---

## 6. After the Sale

- **Leave Feedback** (if applicable) – Helps future buyers trust you.
- **Update Your Listings** – Remove sold items from all platforms.
- **Consider a Warranty** – Some buyers appreciate a brief warranty period (e.g., 30 days).

---

### Quick Checklist

- [ ] Clean & tune guitar
- [ ] Take high‑quality photos
- [ ] Write detailed description
- [ ] Research comparable prices
- [ ] List on chosen platform(s)
- [ ] Respond promptly to inquiries
- [ ] Negotiate fairly
- [ ] Meet safely or ship securely
- [ ] Transfer ownership & leave feedback

---

#### Sample Listing (Reverb)

```
Title: Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition – $280

Description:
- Brand/Model: Yamaha FG800
- Year: 2019
- Wood: Solid spruce top, mahogany back & sides
- Finish: Natural
- Condition: Lightly used, no scratches or cracks, recently tuned
- Extras: New strings, standard guitar case

Price: $280 (Negotiable within 10%)

Shipping: Free shipping within the U.S. (insured). International shipping available upon request.

Contact: Please send a private message with any questions. Thank you!
```

---

Good luck with your sale! If you have any specific questions about a platform or need help drafting a description, just let me know.
